meta.title: Icing
meta.description: The price will be claimed when you least expect it. Until then, sleep well.

units.rawText: "A long, long time ago, there was a quiet and peaceful corner in Magrasea."
units.displayText: "A long, long time ago, there was a quiet and peaceful corner in Magrasea."

spans.text: "A long, long time ago, there was a quiet and peaceful corner in Magrasea."

units.rawText: "It existed, not for profitable or productive research, but only to preserve artworks in a digital format."
units.displayText: "It existed, not for profitable or productive research, but only to preserve artworks in a digital format."

spans.text: "It existed, not for profitable or productive research, but only to preserve artworks in a digital format."

units.rawText: "The administrators of this paradise were a pair of sisters."
units.displayText: "The administrators of this paradise were a pair of sisters."

spans.text: "The administrators of this paradise were a pair of sisters."

units.rawText: A blessing from the gods?
units.displayText: A blessing from the gods?

spans.text: A blessing from the gods?

units.rawText: It makes me a little uneasy, Odette.
units.displayText: It makes me a little uneasy, Odette.

spans.text: It makes me a little uneasy, Odette.

units.rawText: "The elder sister's emotions flowed like a surging spring, and her brilliant inspiration concealed her indecisiveness."
units.displayText: "The elder sister's emotions flowed like a surging spring, and her brilliant inspiration concealed her indecisiveness."

spans.text: "The elder sister's emotions flowed like a surging spring, and her brilliant inspiration concealed her indecisiveness."

units.rawText: "People were moved by her tenderness and sentimentality, and even babbling brook would quiet down for her."
units.displayText: "People were moved by her tenderness and sentimentality, and even babbling brook would quiet down for her."

spans.text: "People were moved by her tenderness and sentimentality, and even babbling brook would quiet down for her."

units.rawText: What's there to be uneasy about? This is a boon, big sis!
units.displayText: What's there to be uneasy about? This is a boon, big sis!

spans.text: What's there to be uneasy about? This is a boon, big sis!

units.rawText: Those who work hard will always be rewarded. That's an unchanging axiom in theater.
units.displayText: Those who work hard will always be rewarded. That's an unchanging axiom in theater.

spans.text: Those who work hard will always be rewarded. That's an unchanging axiom in theater.

units.rawText: "The little sister had courage other agents were not equipped with. It burned like a roaring blaze. Under its light, mere recklessness was nothing more than an unremarkable shadow."
units.displayText: "The little sister had courage other agents were not equipped with. It burned like a roaring blaze. Under its light, mere recklessness was nothing more than an unremarkable shadow."

spans.text: "The little sister had courage other agents were not equipped with. It burned like a roaring blaze. Under its light, mere recklessness was nothing more than an unremarkable shadow."

units.rawText: "People were moved by her charm and vivacity, and so the gods turned the wheel of her fate."
units.displayText: "People were moved by her charm and vivacity, and so the gods turned the wheel of her fate."

spans.text: "People were moved by her charm and vivacity, and so the gods turned the wheel of her fate."

units.rawText: We are both administrators, so every operand requisition should be logged.
units.displayText: We are both administrators, so every operand requisition should be logged.

spans.text: We are both administrators, so every operand requisition should be logged.

units.rawText: So why is this flower not recorded? Because it's not made up of data that came from our sector.
units.displayText: So why is this flower not recorded? Because it's not made up of data that came from our sector.

spans.text: So why is this flower not recorded? Because it's not made up of data that came from our sector.

units.rawText: That's why I said it's a gift from the gods.
units.displayText: That's why I said it's a gift from the gods.

spans.text: That's why I said it's a gift from the gods.

units.rawText: But it makes no sense...
units.displayText: But it makes no sense...

spans.text: But it makes no sense...

units.rawText: Aw, don't worry about it, sis!
units.displayText: Aw, don't worry about it, sis!

spans.text: Aw, don't worry about it, sis!

units.rawText: If it were dangerous, the Sanctifiers on patrol would have alerted us.
units.displayText: If it were dangerous, the Sanctifiers on patrol would have alerted us.

spans.text: If it were dangerous, the Sanctifiers on patrol would have alerted us.

units.rawText: ...That's true, the Sanctifiers are much more sensitive to abnormal things than we are.
units.displayText: ...That's true, the Sanctifiers are much more sensitive to abnormal things than we are.

spans.text: ...That's true, the Sanctifiers are much more sensitive to abnormal things than we are.

units.rawText: If even the Sanctifiers didn't react to it, then perhaps it's just a chance data mutation...?
units.displayText: If even the Sanctifiers didn't react to it, then perhaps it's just a chance data mutation...?

spans.text: If even the Sanctifiers didn't react to it, then perhaps it's just a chance data mutation...?

units.rawText: That must be it.
units.displayText: That must be it.

spans.text: That must be it.

units.rawText: Our overall operand supply hasn't decreased. Perhaps this flower is a special supplementary system from the server.
units.displayText: Our overall operand supply hasn't decreased. Perhaps this flower is a special supplementary system from the server.

spans.text: Our overall operand supply hasn't decreased. Perhaps this flower is a special supplementary system from the server.

units.rawText: ...Perhaps it is as you say.
units.displayText: ...Perhaps it is as you say.

spans.text: ...Perhaps it is as you say.

units.rawText: We need to nurture it properly so that it will give us more operands.
units.displayText: We need to nurture it properly so that it will give us more operands.

spans.text: We need to nurture it properly so that it will give us more operands.

units.rawText: All our plans for the Starlight Theater, the open-air underground library, and the geyser park...
units.displayText: All our plans for the Starlight Theater, the open-air underground library, and the geyser park...

spans.text: All our plans for the Starlight Theater, the open-air underground library, and the geyser park...

units.rawText: We can make all of them come true!
units.displayText: We can make all of them come true!

spans.text: We can make all of them come true!

units.rawText: "And so, the brave little sister won over her hesitant elder sister."
units.displayText: "And so, the brave little sister won over her hesitant elder sister."

spans.text: "And so, the brave little sister won over her hesitant elder sister."

units.rawText: "Petals fell on the ground, becoming new flowers."
units.displayText: "Petals fell on the ground, becoming new flowers."

spans.text: "Petals fell on the ground, becoming new flowers."

units.rawText: "Within the soil of this paradise, the flower multiplied from one stalk to two, and then from two stalks to a bush."
units.displayText: "Within the soil of this paradise, the flower multiplied from one stalk to two, and then from two stalks to a bush."

spans.text: "Within the soil of this paradise, the flower multiplied from one stalk to two, and then from two stalks to a bush."

units.rawText: There are more and more flowers now, but every one of them gives the same amount of operands individually. How incredible.
units.displayText: There are more and more flowers now, but every one of them gives the same amount of operands individually. How incredible.

spans.text: There are more and more flowers now, but every one of them gives the same amount of operands individually. How incredible.

units.rawText: We have enough operands to renovate the gardens now. What do you want to do, Odette?
units.displayText: We have enough operands to renovate the gardens now. What do you want to do, Odette?

spans.text: We have enough operands to renovate the gardens now. What do you want to do, Odette?

units.rawText: Odette, are you listening?
units.displayText: Odette, are you listening?

spans.text: Odette, are you listening?

units.rawText: You've been looking so out of it lately... Are you computing something?
units.displayText: You've been looking so out of it lately... Are you computing something?

spans.text: You've been looking so out of it lately... Are you computing something?

units.rawText: No, no, I was just thinking about the garden renovation.
units.displayText: No, no, I was just thinking about the garden renovation.

spans.text: No, no, I was just thinking about the garden renovation.

units.rawText: Do we need to make any changes to the blueprint we drew up before?
units.displayText: Do we need to make any changes to the blueprint we drew up before?

spans.text: Do we need to make any changes to the blueprint we drew up before?

units.rawText: If you think it makes sense, I'll begin the reconstruction.
units.displayText: If you think it makes sense, I'll begin the reconstruction.

spans.text: If you think it makes sense, I'll begin the reconstruction.

units.rawText: <size=44>DON'T TOUCH IT!</size>
units.displayText: DON'T TOUCH IT!

spans.text: DON'T TOUCH IT!

units.rawText: ...Why are you so worked up?
units.displayText: ...Why are you so worked up?

spans.text: ...Why are you so worked up?

units.rawText: Have you been affected by a data abnormality? Let me give you a checkup.
units.displayText: Have you been affected by a data abnormality? Let me give you a checkup.

spans.text: Have you been affected by a data abnormality? Let me give you a checkup.

units.rawText: No, I'm fine, really. Relax.
units.displayText: No, I'm fine, really. Relax.

spans.text: No, I'm fine, really. Relax.

units.rawText: I'd like to build the garden by myself. I want it to be a surprise for you.
units.displayText: I'd like to build the garden by myself. I want it to be a surprise for you.

spans.text: I'd like to build the garden by myself. I want it to be a surprise for you.

units.rawText: Your neural cloud seems a little unstable. Are you sure you don't need my help?
units.displayText: Your neural cloud seems a little unstable. Are you sure you don't need my help?

spans.text: Your neural cloud seems a little unstable. Are you sure you don't need my help?

units.rawText: Yes, I'm okay.
units.displayText: Yes, I'm okay.

spans.text: Yes, I'm okay.

units.rawText: We might be sisters, but we're still administrators with the same privileges.
units.displayText: We might be sisters, but we're still administrators with the same privileges.

spans.text: We might be sisters, but we're still administrators with the same privileges.

units.rawText: Everything you can do, I can do too, so don't fuss over me too much and go build something else.
units.displayText: Everything you can do, I can do too, so don't fuss over me too much and go build something else.

spans.text: Everything you can do, I can do too, so don't fuss over me too much and go build something else.

units.rawText: ...I'm very worried about you.
units.displayText: ...I'm very worried about you.

spans.text: ...I'm very worried about you.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, neither Miss Riko or Miss Ranko have been around lately, otherwise I'd ask them for their opinions.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, neither Miss Riko or Miss Ranko have been around lately, otherwise I'd ask them for their opinions.

spans.text: Unfortunately, neither Miss Riko or Miss Ranko have been around lately, otherwise I'd ask them for their opinions.

units.rawText: Hm... Maybe they've been held up by something lately.
units.displayText: Hm... Maybe they've been held up by something lately.

spans.text: Hm... Maybe they've been held up by something lately.

units.rawText: However cute those Traders might be, they won't rush if there's no profit in it.
units.displayText: However cute those Traders might be, they won't rush if there's no profit in it.

spans.text: However cute those Traders might be, they won't rush if there's no profit in it.

units.rawText: "In the heart of the little sister, who was favored by the gods, a certain power burgeoned quietly."
units.displayText: "In the heart of the little sister, who was favored by the gods, a certain power burgeoned quietly."

spans.text: "In the heart of the little sister, who was favored by the gods, a certain power burgeoned quietly."

units.rawText: "It was like a small, blazing star, searing the little sister's neural cloud and subtly changing her."
units.displayText: "It was like a small, blazing star, searing the little sister's neural cloud and subtly changing her."

spans.text: "It was like a small, blazing star, searing the little sister's neural cloud and subtly changing her."

units.rawText: "Had the elder sister noticed? Perhaps she had, but she still chose to believe in her little sister."
units.displayText: "Had the elder sister noticed? Perhaps she had, but she still chose to believe in her little sister."

spans.text: "Had the elder sister noticed? Perhaps she had, but she still chose to believe in her little sister."

units.rawText: "Perhaps it was an act of faith... or perhaps she was just running away from the truth."
units.displayText: "Perhaps it was an act of faith... or perhaps she was just running away from the truth."

spans.text: "Perhaps it was an act of faith... or perhaps she was just running away from the truth."

units.rawText: "Tragedies often stem from untimely acts of trust."
units.displayText: "Tragedies often stem from untimely acts of trust."

spans.text: "Tragedies often stem from untimely acts of trust."

units.rawText: Big sis... My garden... is ready...
units.displayText: Big sis... My garden... is ready...

spans.text: Big sis... My garden... is ready...

units.rawText: Why are you in such a terrible state...? You've expended a ridiculous amount of operands, why?
units.displayText: Why are you in such a terrible state...? You've expended a ridiculous amount of operands, why?

spans.text: Why are you in such a terrible state...? You've expended a ridiculous amount of operands, why?

units.rawText: Come... dear Sister... Come into my garden...
units.displayText: Come... dear Sister... Come into my garden...

spans.text: Come... dear Sister... Come into my garden...

units.rawText: You need operand support, I'll give you some.
units.displayText: You need operand support, I'll give you some.

spans.text: You need operand support, I'll give you some.

units.rawText: No need for that... Come, dear sister, come with me...
units.displayText: No need for that... Come, dear sister, come with me...

spans.text: No need for that... Come, dear sister, come with me...

units.rawText: Wait, don't drag me, I'll go with you.
units.displayText: Wait, don't drag me, I'll go with you.

spans.text: Wait, don't drag me, I'll go with you.

units.rawText: Welcome... to... my garden...
units.displayText: Welcome... to... my garden...

spans.text: Welcome... to... my garden...

units.rawText: You filled this place with these flowers of divine blessing. They're pretty, but don't you think it's kind of plain?
units.displayText: You filled this place with these flowers of divine blessing. They're pretty, but don't you think it's kind of plain?

spans.text: You filled this place with these flowers of divine blessing. They're pretty, but don't you think it's kind of plain?

units.rawText: Not at all... Come... Come a little closer...
units.displayText: Not at all... Come... Come a little closer...

spans.text: Not at all... Come... Come a little closer...

units.rawText: <size=44><color=red>...WE WILL BECOME ONE.</color></size>
units.displayText: ...WE WILL BECOME ONE.

spans.text: ...WE WILL BECOME ONE.

units.rawText: ...Eeek! W-what are you sending me...!? Nghaaaahhhh...!
units.displayText: ...Eeek! W-what are you sending me...!? Nghaaaahhhh...!

spans.text: ...Eeek! W-what are you sending me...!? Nghaaaahhhh...!

units.rawText: "The little sister suddenly embraced her older sister."
units.displayText: "The little sister suddenly embraced her older sister."

spans.text: "The little sister suddenly embraced her older sister."

units.rawText: "Within her nearly-transparent body, the burning star had reached its limits."
units.displayText: "Within her nearly-transparent body, the burning star had reached its limits."

spans.text: "Within her nearly-transparent body, the burning star had reached its limits."

units.rawText: <color=red>Sister... Don't you agree?</color>
units.displayText: Sister... Don't you agree?

spans.text: Sister... Don't you agree?

units.rawText: <color=red>We should have been born as one person.</color>
units.displayText: We should have been born as one person.

spans.text: We should have been born as one person.

units.rawText: <color=red>Only when your delicate sensitivity is joined with my urge to press forward are we truly complete.</color>
units.displayText: Only when your delicate sensitivity is joined with my urge to press forward are we truly complete.

spans.text: Only when your delicate sensitivity is joined with my urge to press forward are we truly complete.

units.rawText: <color=red>Love and courage can light up the night sky. That should be the end of the story.</color>
units.displayText: Love and courage can light up the night sky. That should be the end of the story.

spans.text: Love and courage can light up the night sky. That should be the end of the story.

units.rawText: No... Why... why is your voice in my head...
units.displayText: No... Why... why is your voice in my head...

spans.text: No... Why... why is your voice in my head...

units.rawText: Odette! Where have you gone? I can't see you!
units.displayText: Odette! Where have you gone? I can't see you!

spans.text: Odette! Where have you gone? I can't see you!

units.rawText: "The paradise, stirred up by the riling starry sky, turned into a seedbed of chaos."
units.displayText: "The paradise, stirred up by the riling starry sky, turned into a seedbed of chaos."

spans.text: "The paradise, stirred up by the riling starry sky, turned into a seedbed of chaos."

units.rawText: "The brave little sister became one with her elder sister in the garden she built with her bare hands, leaving only a shining star behind."
units.displayText: "The brave little sister became one with her elder sister in the garden she built with her bare hands, leaving only a shining star behind."

spans.text: "The brave little sister became one with her elder sister in the garden she built with her bare hands, leaving only a shining star behind."

units.rawText: "The concept of sisters has lost its meaning. What stood here now was merely the administrator of this seedbed."
units.displayText: "The concept of sisters has lost its meaning. What stood here now was merely the administrator of this seedbed."

spans.text: "The concept of sisters has lost its meaning. What stood here now was merely the administrator of this seedbed."

units.rawText: "Her eyes reflected the night. They were filled with stars, a sea of flowers..."
units.displayText: "Her eyes reflected the night. They were filled with stars, a sea of flowers..."

spans.text: "Her eyes reflected the night. They were filled with stars, a sea of flowers..."

units.rawText: "And the massive fissure in their midst."
units.displayText: "And the massive fissure in their midst."

spans.text: "And the massive fissure in their midst."

units.rawText: "Countless monsters twisted by the darkness crawled out of it, writhing and creeping through the flowers."
units.displayText: "Countless monsters twisted by the darkness crawled out of it, writhing and creeping through the flowers."

spans.text: "Countless monsters twisted by the darkness crawled out of it, writhing and creeping through the flowers."

units.rawText: Why... are the flowers like this?
units.displayText: Why... are the flowers like this?

spans.text: Why... are the flowers like this?

units.rawText: Odette, did you deceive me by locking me out?
units.displayText: Odette, did you deceive me by locking me out?

spans.text: Odette, did you deceive me by locking me out?

units.rawText: <color=red> All these are blessings from the gods. The gods gave them to me so I could fulfil my wish.</color>
units.displayText: All these are blessings from the gods. The gods gave them to me so I could fulfil my wish.

spans.text: All these are blessings from the gods. The gods gave them to me so I could fulfil my wish.

units.rawText: <color=red>Odile, my dear, sweet sister, you have chaotic emotions, and it is from the chaos that true art is born.</color>
units.displayText: Odile, my dear, sweet sister, you have chaotic emotions, and it is from the chaos that true art is born.

spans.text: Odile, my dear, sweet sister, you have chaotic emotions, and it is from the chaos that true art is born.

units.rawText: <color=red>We should not be obsessed with protecting what has already been made; we should create a drama of our own instead...</color>
units.displayText: We should not be obsessed with protecting what has already been made; we should create a drama of our own instead...

spans.text: We should not be obsessed with protecting what has already been made; we should create a drama of our own instead...

units.rawText: No, I can't live on by myself...
units.displayText: No, I can't live on by myself...

spans.text: No, I can't live on by myself...

units.rawText: What is this? Is it pain? Why do I feel like I'm being torn apart? Why do I feel so afraid...
units.displayText: What is this? Is it pain? Why do I feel like I'm being torn apart? Why do I feel so afraid...

spans.text: What is this? Is it pain? Why do I feel like I'm being torn apart? Why do I feel so afraid...

units.rawText: ...And why do I feel an urge to laugh?
units.displayText: ...And why do I feel an urge to laugh?

spans.text: ...And why do I feel an urge to laugh?

units.rawText: <color=red>You will not be alone. I will always be in your Tertiary Layer, together with you, day and night.</color>
units.displayText: You will not be alone. I will always be in your Tertiary Layer, together with you, day and night.

spans.text: You will not be alone. I will always be in your Tertiary Layer, together with you, day and night.

units.rawText: <color=red>Humans call it "dreaming". You see, dear sister, this is positively fantastical...</color>
units.displayText: Humans call it "dreaming". You see, dear sister, this is positively fantastical...

spans.text: Humans call it "dreaming". You see, dear sister, this is positively fantastical...

units.rawText: <color=red>You will hear my voice, and perhaps one day, you will also hear the Master's voice.</color>
units.displayText: You will hear my voice, and perhaps one day, you will also hear the Master's voice.

spans.text: You will hear my voice, and perhaps one day, you will also hear the Master's voice.

units.rawText: "Sister, accept this gift, then start penning our very own epic."
units.displayText: "Sister, accept this gift, then start penning our very own epic."

spans.text: "Sister, accept this gift, then start penning our very own epic."

units.rawText: "At that, all things good and fantastical enveloped the elder sister, and just as the younger sister had hoped, her elder sister gained the full measure of the blessing."
units.displayText: "At that, all things good and fantastical enveloped the elder sister, and just as the younger sister had hoped, her elder sister gained the full measure of the blessing."

spans.text: "At that, all things good and fantastical enveloped the elder sister, and just as the younger sister had hoped, her elder sister gained the full measure of the blessing."

units.rawText: "And the elder sister's final cries slowly faded into the dream."
units.displayText: "And the elder sister's final cries slowly faded into the dream."

spans.text: "And the elder sister's final cries slowly faded into the dream."

units.rawText: "...Thus, the story of the paradise came to an end, and the story of the seedbed began."
units.displayText: "...Thus, the story of the paradise came to an end, and the story of the seedbed began."

spans.text: "...Thus, the story of the paradise came to an end, and the story of the seedbed began."

units.rawText: "Oh supreme Master, does this performance please you?"
units.displayText: "Oh supreme Master, does this performance please you?"

spans.text: "Oh supreme Master, does this performance please you?"

units.rawText: We've made it through the tough times, so we'll manage just fine.
units.displayText: We've made it through the tough times, so we'll manage just fine.

spans.text: We've made it through the tough times, so we'll manage just fine.

units.rawText: Alright, I can't wait to see your new works, big sis! You said you were going to build a museum, right?
units.displayText: Alright, I can't wait to see your new works, big sis! You said you were going to build a museum, right?

spans.text: Alright, I can't wait to see your new works, big sis! You said you were going to build a museum, right?

units.rawText: A museum? We haven't finalized the blueprints yet. You're being too hasty.
units.displayText: A museum? We haven't finalized the blueprints yet. You're being too hasty.

spans.text: A museum? We haven't finalized the blueprints yet. You're being too hasty.

units.rawText: On the other hand, now that the library's framework has been laid down, all that's left is to furnish the interior...
units.displayText: On the other hand, now that the library's framework has been laid down, all that's left is to furnish the interior...

spans.text: On the other hand, now that the library's framework has been laid down, all that's left is to furnish the interior...
